content_html:
On-device voice cloning

Free · In-App Purchases

ClearVoice is an on-device text to speech app, using the latest state of the art OmniVoice model. All voices are generated offline, and saved only to your own device, no sign-up or internet connection is required. Great for generating audiobooks, public announcements, and language practice. Features: • Generate natural language speech from text • Clone a voice with only 10 seconds of audio and a transcript • Generate audio in over 250 languages • Share audio easily after generation Disclaimer: The included voices are for demonstration purposes only, please only use your own authorised voices. Always obtain consent before cloning and sharing.
